# FLX-2109: no applied run at this run id

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim verify` and `fluxsim ship` read a run directory `fluxsim apply` wrote: the receipt and the run digest are the artifacts they check. Neither is present at this run id in this state directory, so there is nothing to verify or ship. Run `fluxsim apply` (or `fluxsim run`) first, then pass the run id it reports.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2109
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
